Name: Revisions for Seasonal Outfits - Elliott 1.6
Author: JennericUsername
Description:
This mod revises Elliott's portraits from the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url].﻿

All credit for the original mod and portraits goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url].
Credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2828626]LeiAili[/url]'s mod and revisions to these portraits before the 1.6 update.
[b][size=3]
YOU MUST INSTALL SEASONAL OUTFITS MOD FIRST IN ORDER FOR THIS MOD TO WORK.[/size]
[/b]
[size=5]Changes included:[/size]

[list]
[*]Updated Elliott's portraits for spring, summer, fall, winter indoors, winter outdoors, and all festivals.
[*]Beach portrait was not updated, since the outfit used is the same as in the vanilla game.

[*]Sprites were not updated, since they already match the portraits.
[/list]  
[size=5]Installation:[/size]
 [list]
[*][b]DO NOT USE A MOD MANAGER. [/b]Download mod manually and unzip.
[*]Copy the "assets" folder into the Seasonal Outfits mod folder (most likely
C:\Program Files\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters) and overwrite all changes.[*]To use the vanilla beach sprite that matches the portrait, go to \assets\Characters\Elliott
and delete the file named Elliott_Beach.png. This will remove the ponytail that the Seasonal Outfits mod gave him.[*]Run game as normal
[/list]
